name: Group Theoretic Isomorphism
description: Translates a graph connectivity problem into a group generation problem. The edges of a tree are represented as a minimal set of transpositions generating the symmetric group. Connecting a target set of vertices is exactly equivalent to selecting a subset of transpositions whose generated subgroup contains all pairwise transpositions of the target elements. This hides all graph-related keywords (tree, path, connected) while maintaining a rigorous 1:1 mathematical isomorphism.
